description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rate of Exchange effective from 21.11.2016 to 27.11.2016
reasoning: This gazette notification is issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) and establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges. It represents a regulatory framework for customs operations, specifically determining how customs valuations and payments should be calculated. This falls under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes as it involves statutory instruments and regulatory compliance requirements for customs operations, rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or any of the other specialized categories.
